name: Weighted Chin-Up
steps: While standing, fasten the plate to a dip belt and check that its attachment is closed.
Take a shoulder-width underhand grip and settle into a straight-arm hang with the plate still.
Pull your chest smoothly upward by driving your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower to a controlled hang, stand securely and detach the plate.
tips: Keep your legs still so the added weight does not swing and throw off your vertical pull.
Maintain full range of motion from straight arms at the bottom to chin clearly above the bar.
